value.deck: A specific software tool used by companies to handle their data will stop getting updates and support this November.
shortVersion: Microsoft has announced that a specific version of a software tool called Azure Databricks Runtime 10.4 LTS will no longer be supported starting November 1, 2026. Think of this software as a specific engine that helps companies process and manage large amounts of information in the cloud.

After this date, this particular engine won't receive any more security updates, bug fixes, or help from Microsoft. This means if companies continue to use it, their data could be at risk from new problems or security threats.

Because of this, any teams currently using this older version must switch to a newer, supported version before the November deadline. This ensures their data stays safe and their operations run smoothly without interruption.
value.plainLanguage: Companies using a specific version of Microsoft's data-handling software need to update it by November 2026 to keep their information safe and systems running.

keyTerms.meaning: Imagine a specific set of instructions and tools that a computer program needs to run properly. A "runtime" is like the operating environment or engine that makes a particular software work.

When a software or product reaches its "End of Life," it means the company that made it will no longer provide updates, fixes, or support. It's like a car model that's no longer being manufactured or serviced by the original company.

These are small pieces of code or updates designed to fix weaknesses in software that could be exploited by hackers. They are like quick repairs to seal a leak in a pipe, protecting your data from harm.
In the world of computers, "migration" means moving data, applications, or entire systems from one place or version to another. It's like moving all your belongings from an old house to a new one.

value.whyItMatters: This matters because many companies rely on these software tools to manage important information, from customer details to financial records. If they don't update their systems, their valuable data could become vulnerable to security breaches, or their services might stop working correctly, affecting their customers.
watchNext: Keep an eye out for similar announcements from other software companies about older versions of their tools.
Notice how companies respond to these deadlines to ensure their systems remain secure and functional.
Understand that keeping software up-to-date is a continuous process for businesses to protect their information.
